description: This Java source file defines the BatchCallHandler class, which implements the BatchFilterChain interface to manage a sequence of BatchFilter objects for processing batch requests in a chain. It uses a list of filters and applies them sequentially, ultimately invoking a provided lastElement function when all filters have been processed.

classes.name: BatchCallHandler
classes.description: Handles the execution chain of batch filters and manages the progression through the filter list.

methods.name: serviceCall
methods.description: Processes a batch request through the filter chain or invokes the final handling function if all filters are processed.
